subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: Should this umbrella remain open as the maintainer coordination issue while narrower canonical issues/PRs own dashboard auth, Codex OAuth propagation, runtime atomicity, and context/final-turn recovery, or should maintainers replace it with one narrower canonical tracker?
rationale: The evidence shows multiple partially fixed and still-open subproblems, but choosing the supported auth persistence model, OAuth propagation boundary, and issue split is a maintainer product/security decision rather than a safe automated cleanup close.

options.title: Keep and split by boundary
options.body: Keep this issue open as the coordination anchor, link the existing focused issues and PRs, and create or reuse narrower trackers for runtime atomicity and context hygiene before implementation.

options.title: Replace with one canonical tracker
options.body: Close this only after maintainers create a single clearer canonical issue that preserves the dashboard, auth, runtime, final-turn, and context evidence from this report.

options.title: Close after linked fixes land
options.body: Wait for the open dashboard/auth candidates and remaining Codex/OAuth proof to land, then re-review whether the umbrella is implemented or stale.

recommendation.title: Keep and split by boundary
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the coordination anchor, link the existing focused issues and PRs, and create or reuse narrower trackers for runtime atomicity and context hygiene before implementation.
